title: Shared Calendar Travel Countdown Readiness
dataSources: Shared calendar events (`sharedcalendar:event`), gift budget items (`giftbudget:item`), touchpoint logs (`touchpoint:log`), and relationship rituals (`relationship:ritual`).
app: Relationship and togetherness telemetry from shared calendars, gift budgets, message and call logs, and long-distance touchpoint trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sharedcalendar:event
| search event_type="travel" readiness_pct=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(readiness_pct) as readiness_pct by _time trip_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks travel countdown readiness over time and breaks it out by trip.
value: A readiness trend for each trip helps separate fun anticipation from last-minute scramble.
implementation: Send travel countdown readiness events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of travel countdown readiness by trip.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how travel countdown readiness changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
